qwen_embedding.query_instruction: Given an identity-, period- and source-bound financial retrieval need, retrieve a passage that directly serves the stated evidence role. Related background is not direct evidence.

qwen_reranker.instruction: Rank source-bound financial candidates by direct answerability, correct evidence role, fact state, issuer, period and relationship direction. Abstain from promoting merely related background.

bge_embedding.node_purpose: Generate dense, learned-sparse and multi-vector candidate signals on the same sentence-level financial object population.
bge_embedding.input_scale: 33085 objects once plus at most 180 bounded retrieval needs; candidate-only, no Evidence promotion.
bge_embedding.schema_burden: numeric arrays and immutable cache manifest only
bge_embedding.materiality_and_quality_risk: truncation may hide the precise evidence-bearing sentence; 512 tokens covers each compiled object whose renderer is capped at 2400 characters
bge_embedding.comparable_run_evidence: prior 20340-object BGE cache completed in about 193 seconds; expanded sentence objects increase count by about 63 percent
bge_embedding.reasoning_profile: local retrieval encoder; no generative reasoning
bge_embedding.stop_and_truncation: maximum 512 tokens, batch 4, fail on object/cache identity drift, no silent object omission

qwen_embedding.node_purpose: Provide an independent semantic challenger using exactly the same objects, needs and hard filters.
qwen_embedding.input_scale: 33085 objects once plus at most 180 bounded retrieval needs.
qwen_embedding.materiality_and_quality_risk: a semantic challenger may increase topical noise; it cannot become the default unless it adds reviewed positives without increasing critical false promotion
qwen_embedding.comparable_run_evidence: prior 20340-object Qwen cache completed in about 376 seconds and improved some query-atom recall while remaining unstable at the head
qwen_embedding.reasoning_profile: local retrieval encoder; no generative reasoning
qwen_embedding.stop_and_truncation: maximum 512 tokens, batch 8, fail on model/object identity drift, no network fallback

bge_reranker.node_purpose: Reorder at most the shared 96-candidate pool per atom without changing candidate membership.
bge_reranker.input_scale: at most 1728 query-candidate pairs across 18 atoms plus bounded VS1/VS2 replay pairs.
bge_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: semantic similarity can promote wrong evidence roles; Evidence Role remains an independent gate and the reranker has no authority
bge_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: prior controlled BGE reranker showed insufficient natural-pool quality and remains a shadow challenger
bge_reranker.stop_and_truncation: maximum 1024 tokens, batch 2, exact score-count match required

qwen_reranker.node_purpose: Independent same-pool financial relevance challenger, not a second candidate generator.
qwen_reranker.input_scale: at most 1728 query-candidate pairs across 18 atoms plus bounded VS1/VS2 replay pairs.
qwen_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: instruction-following may improve role separation but cannot override issuer, period, relationship or Evidence authority
qwen_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: prior Qwen reranker surfaced more positives than BGE on natural pools but did not prove stable hard-negative suppression
qwen_reranker.stop_and_truncation: maximum 1024 tokens, batch 2, exact score-count match required

stop_conditions: Do not tune against ORCL, ASML, ANET or any hidden qualification case.
Do not inject qrel IDs, target object IDs or answer URLs into RetrievalNeed generation.
Do not call a reranker improvement when its first-stage pool lacked the target.
Do not convert table or narrative ranking scores into NumericFact authority.
Do not force a model route into production merely because VS3 was scheduled to choose a winner.
Do not declare a public-information gap from a retrieval miss before local object, index, tool execution and acquisition eligibility are receipted.
